description: This file defines the CellAlignment class, which provides methods to map alignment settings such as horizontal and vertical alignment and text wrapping from the PHPSpreadsheet's Alignment object to internal integer codes used for XLS file writing.

classes.name: CellAlignment
classes.description: A utility class that maps Alignment object properties to integer codes for horizontal alignment, vertical alignment, and text wrapping in XLS file format.

methods.name: horizontal
methods.description: Returns an integer code representing the horizontal alignment based on the Alignment object, defaulting to 'general' if unspecified.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Returns 1 if text wrapping is enabled in the Alignment object, otherwise 0.

methods.name: vertical
methods.description: Returns an integer code representing the vertical alignment based on the Alignment object, defaulting to 'bottom' if unspecified.
